reviews.title: Great product at a great price
reviews.body: I installed this hitch on my 2016 BMW X5. It was fairly easy to install after watching a few videos on YouTube. I was able to do it by myself. You need something to support the bumper cover after removing it. I didn’t have to unplug the sensor with the way I did it. Removing the old bumper was very easy. Installing the new bumper/hitch was easy as well. It’s a very solid hitch and a much improved bumper. I’m very happy with my purchase and I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Perfect fit for the X5 F15 platform.
reviews.body:
Perfect fit for the X5 F15 platform. Complete replacement of stock shock bar with this hitch and fits like a glove. Also hitch material much thicker than stock, way stronger and sturdy. Instructions that came in the box is useless. There are several good quality videos on YouTube to follow step by step. Watch for torque specs and if you think it is too tight it is because it probably is! Also the plastic fixture on the tire internal protection is something you need to be gentle. Also be careful with the ultrasound sensor connector inside the bumper cover and the wire path to avoid being pressed by the hitch.
In general, very happy with the new hitch and easy to install.

reviews.title: Great, sturdy, professional looking trailer hitch.
reviews.body: Relatively easy to install, very sturdy and well made. I highly recommend. One note: you will not be able to reinstall your rear bumper absorber on a 2008 BMW X5 like the one I have.
